# Nucleux

> Agentic UI component library for React — AI chat / agent interfaces.
> Published as a pnpm-workspace monorepo under the `@nucleux` scope (one package per component + umbrella `@nucleux/react`).

## Install

```sh
pnpm add @nucleux/react    # umbrella (re-exports all components)
# or individual packages:
pnpm add @nucleux/dialog @nucleux/button @nucleux/alert
```

## Usage

```tsx
import { Dialog, Button, Alert } from "@nucleux/react";

// All components use Tailwind CSS tokens (bg-muted, text-foreground, etc.)
// Import the tokens preset once in your app:
//   import "@nucleux/tokens/preset";
```

## Design tokens

- CSS custom properties (`--nx-*`) in `@nucleux/tokens` (`packages/tokens/src/globals.css`).
- Tailwind preset: `@nucleux/tokens/preset` — maps tokens to `bg-*`, `text-*`, `border-*` utilities.
- Palette: shadcn/Tailwind **slate** base; accents: `info` (blue CTA), `brand` (violet), `success`, `warning`, `destructive`.
- Light/dark theming via `.dark` class on `<html>`.
- **Only use semantic tokens** (`bg-muted`, `text-foreground`, `text-success`…) — never hardcode hex values.

## Component conventions

- One component per package; kebab-case package name, PascalCase exports.
- Every component exports its `Props` type and ships a co-located `*.stories.tsx`.
- Merge classes with `cn()` from `@nucleux/utils`.
- All components are re-exported by `@nucleux/react` via `export *`.
- `forwardRef` on all function components.

## Naming conventions (important for AI agents)

| Concept | Nucleux name | Common alias (deprecated, still accepted) |
|---|---|---|
| Alert severity | `variant` | `severity` (Alert) |
| Color/emphasis | `variant` | `color` (Button) |
| Popover alignment | `align` | `alignItems` (PopoverContent) |
| Modal header | `DialogHeader` | `ModalHeader` (re-export alias) |
| Modal title | `DialogTitle` | `ModalTitle` (re-export alias) |
| Modal description | `DialogDescription` | `ModalDescription` (re-export alias) |
| Modal footer | `DialogFooter` | `ModalFooter` (re-export alias) |

When in doubt, use `variant` — it is the universal prop for visual emphasis/severity in Nucleux.
The deprecated aliases exist so agents trained on MUI/Chakra vocabulary are caught and mapped 1:1
(e.g. Alert `severity="error"` behaves as `variant="destructive"`), but prefer the canonical names.

## ShadCN fallback policy

Nucleux ships agentic-AI-specific components. For standard primitives Nucleux does not ship
(e.g. `Calendar`, `DatePicker`, `Combobox`), fall back to **shadcn/ui**. The MCP server
(`@nucleux/mcp`) encodes this fallback in its catalog and tool definitions.

## MCP server

- Package: `@nucleux/mcp` — an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server exposing the component catalog to AI agents.
- Catalog: `packages/mcp/src/catalog.json` (auto-generated by `scripts/gen-mcp-catalog.mjs`).
- Regenerate after adding/renaming components: `pnpm --filter @nucleux/mcp run gen-catalog`.

## Skills

- `.claude/skills/figma-to-nucleux` — build a Nucleux component from a Figma design.
- `.claude/skills/validate-component` — validate a component against Nucleux conventions.

## Commands

- `pnpm dev` — Storybook
- `pnpm typecheck` — TypeScript strict check
- `pnpm test` — Vitest + Testing Library + jest-axe
- `pnpm build` — tsup build all packages (ESM + CJS + .d.ts)
- `pnpm validate` — full gate (typecheck → test → build → build-storybook)

## Component catalog (77 packages)

### Components (73)

- **accordion** (`@nucleux/accordion`) — A vertically stacked set of collapsible panels.
  Exports: `Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, AccordionContent, AccordionProps, AccordionItemProps`
- **action-confirmation** (`@nucleux/action-confirmation`) — A guardrail shown before an agent performs a consequential or irreversible
action — states the action, its impact, and requires explicit confirmation.
Source: Figma "Recovery / Verification".
  Exports: `ActionConfirmation, ActionConfirmationVariant, ActionConfirmationProps`
- **action-plan** (`@nucleux/action-plan`) — A single step in an {@link ActionPlan}. Numbered automatically by its order.
  Exports: `ActionPlanStep, ActionPlan, ActionPlanStepProps, ActionPlanProps`
- **action-tile** (`@nucleux/action-tile`) — A large, selectable action card — icon in an accent container, a title, and a
short description. Used for entry points like "Record a meeting" /
"Upload a recording" / "Paste a link".
  Exports: `ActionTile, ActionTileProps`
- **activity-log** (`@nucleux/activity-log`) — A single entry in an {@link ActivityLog}: an action the agent took, with a timestamp.
  Exports: `ActivityLogItem, ActivityLog, ActivityLogItemProps, ActivityLogProps`
- **agent-composer** (`@nucleux/agent-composer`) — An agent task composer — a card with an auto-growing prompt field and a
toolbar (left actions, right actions, and a send/stop button). Enter submits,
Shift+Enter inserts a newline. Source: Figma "Agentic".
  Exports: `AgentComposer, AgentComposerProps`
- **agent-steps** (`@nucleux/agent-steps`) — A single step in an {@link AgentSteps} tracker.
  Exports: `AgentStep, AgentSteps, AgentStepStatus, AgentStepProps, AgentStepsProps`
- **ai-disclosure** (`@nucleux/ai-disclosure`) — A provenance marker that content was authored or assisted by AI — an
anti-deception trust signal, as an inline pill, corner badge, or banner.
Source: Figma "Trust & Disclosure / AI disclosure".
  Exports: `AiDisclosure, AiCaveat, AiDisclosureVariant, AiDisclosureProps, AiCaveatProps`
- **alert** (`@nucleux/alert`) — Contextual message banner — info, success, warning, or error. Also accepts a deprecated `severity` prop (alias of `variant`).
  Exports: `Alert, AlertVariant, AlertProps`
- **attachment-tile** (`@nucleux/attachment-tile`) — A removable preview of a file or image attached as context to an agent turn —
document chip or image thumbnail. The multimodal-context affordance.
Source: Figma "Context Expansion / File Attachment".
  Exports: `AttachmentTile, AttachmentTray, AttachmentTileProps, AttachmentTrayProps`
- **audio-message** (`@nucleux/audio-message`) — A player for AI-generated spoken output — play/pause, a waveform, duration,
and an optional transcript.
Source: Figma "Output & Processing / Audio player output".
  Exports: `AudioMessage, AudioMessageProps`
- **avatar** (`@nucleux/avatar`) — Avatar for a conversation participant or entity — image, initials, or role icon.
  Exports: `Avatar, AvatarProps`
- **badge** (`@nucleux/badge`) — Compact status pill — action counts, states ("Summarized"), progress ("1/3 Done").
  Exports: `Badge, BadgeVariant, BadgeProps`
- **breadcrumb** (`@nucleux/breadcrumb`) — Breadcrumb navigation landmark. Compose with the parts below.
  Exports: `Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbLink, BreadcrumbPage, BreadcrumbSeparator`
- **button** (`@nucleux/button`) — Button — variants, sizes, and icons — Nucleux agentic UI for React. Also accepts a deprecated `color` prop (alias of `variant`).
  Exports: `Button, ButtonVariant, ButtonSize, ButtonProps`
- **capability-overview** (`@nucleux/capability-overview`) — A first-run card that sets expectations for an agent — what it can do, and
where it falls short — as Examples / Capabilities / Limits columns.
Source: Figma "Onboarding / Generic Assistant Overview".
  Exports: `CapabilityOverview, CapabilitySection, CapabilityOverviewProps`
- **card** (`@nucleux/card`) — Card header. Lays children out in a row with space-between by default.
  Exports: `CardContainer, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardAction, CardContent, CardDivider, …`
- **checkbox** (`@nucleux/checkbox`) — Accessible checkbox (role=checkbox). Controlled via `checked` or uncontrolled.
  Exports: `Checkbox, CheckboxProps`
- **checklist** (`@nucleux/checklist`) — A single step in a {@link Checklist}.
  Exports: `ChecklistItem, Checklist, ChecklistItemProps, ChecklistProps`
- **chip** (`@nucleux/chip`) — A small rounded tag/pill with an optional status dot and removable affordance.
Lighter-weight than {@link Badge} — use for filters, tokens, and inline tags.
  Exports: `Chip, ChipProps`
- **citation** (`@nucleux/citation`) — An inline citation chip embedded in an AI answer — a compact numbered or
domain marker that attributes a claim to a source.
Source: Figma "Explainability / Inline source chip".
  Exports: `Citation, SourceItem, SourceList, CitationProps, SourceItemProps, SourceListProps`
- **code-block** (`@nucleux/code-block`) — A code surface with a language label and copy-to-clipboard button. Syntax
highlighting is intentionally left to the consumer (bring your own
highlighter such as Shiki) so the library stays dependency-light.
  Exports: `CodeBlock, CodeBlockProps`
- **confidence-indicator** (`@nucleux/confidence-indicator`) — A model-confidence meter with a review threshold — surfaces how certain the
agent is about its own answer and gates autonomous action on it.
Source: Figma "Explainability / Confidence Indicators".
  Exports: `ConfidenceIndicator, ConfidenceLevel, ConfidenceIndicatorProps`
- **connector-card** (`@nucleux/connector-card`) — A card to enable an external tool or data connector for the agent — icon,
name, what it unlocks, and a connect action.
Source: Figma "Context Expansion / Connector suggestion card".
  Exports: `ConnectorCard, ConnectorCardProps`
- **dialog** (`@nucleux/dialog`) — A modal dialog. Controlled via `open` / `onOpenChange`. Renders an overlay and Also re-exports deprecated `ModalHeader`/`ModalTitle`/`ModalDescription`/`ModalFooter` aliases.
a centered panel; closes on overlay click or Escape (unless `dismissible` is
false). Compose with DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription, DialogFooter.
  Exports: `Dialog, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogProps`
- **error-state** (`@nucleux/error-state`) — A centered empty / failure state — icon, title, description and recovery
actions. The AI-failure variant is the "your prompt didn't go through, your
draft is saved" recovery card.
Source: Figma "Recovery / Error & Empty States".
  Exports: `ErrorState, ErrorStateVariant, ErrorStateProps`
- **follow-up** (`@nucleux/follow-up`) — An AI answer that surfaces the assumption it made, with a chip to change it —
for when a response would otherwise silently guess missing intent.
Source: Figma "AIUX / Follow Up".
  Exports: `FollowUp, FollowUpAssumption, FollowUpProps`
- **getting-started-pill** (`@nucleux/getting-started-pill`) — A floating, collapsed onboarding launcher — an icon, a label, a progress
badge, and a chevron that toggles the expanded panel. Click toggles `open`
via `onClick`. Source: Figma `getting-started-collapsed`.
  Exports: `GettingStartedPill, GettingStartedPillProps`
- **global-nav** (`@nucleux/global-nav`) — Top application navigation bar. A fixed-height (64px) bar with three zones:
`left`, `center`, and `right`. Pass slots, or `children` for full control.
  Exports: `GlobalNav, GlobalNavProps`
- **icon-button** (`@nucleux/icon-button`) — Square icon-only button — nav rails, toolbars, card actions.
  Exports: `IconButton, IconButtonVariant, IconButtonSize, IconButtonProps`
- **inline-feedback** (`@nucleux/inline-feedback`) — A compact toolbar beneath an AI response: copy, rate (thumbs up/down) and

Source: Figma "Expressive Input / Inline Feedback Controls".
  Exports: `InlineFeedback, FeedbackRating, InlineFeedbackProps`
- **input-bar** (`@nucleux/input-bar`) — Auto-resizing chat composer. Enter submits, Shift+Enter inserts a newline.
While `loading`, the send button becomes a stop button wired to `onStop`.
  Exports: `InputBar, InputBarProps`
- **knowledge-base-picker** (`@nucleux/knowledge-base-picker`) — A selectable list of context files/knowledge sources an agent may draw on —

- **link-button** (`@nucleux/link-button`) — A link-styled action — underlined, semibold text with optional icons. Renders
an `<a>` when `href` is provided, otherwise a `<button>` for in-app actions.
  Exports: `LinkButton, LinkButtonProps`
- **media-card** (`@nucleux/media-card`) — A media card — a media area (image/video) with a title, description, and
optional footer. Covers the "Card Variation" family from the design system
via `orientation` and the media slot. Source: Figma "Card Variation *".
  Exports: `MediaCard, MediaCardProps`
- **memory-summary** (`@nucleux/memory-summary`) — The user-facing view of an agent's long-term memory — grouped facts it holds

Source: Figma "Memory and Continuity / Memory summary".
  Exports: `MemorySummary, MemoryGroup, MemorySummaryProps`
- **menu** (`@nucleux/menu`) — A menu surface (dropdown / context menu panel). Presentational — pair with
your own trigger/positioning. Compose with MenuItem, MenuSeparator, MenuLabel.
  Exports: `Menu, MenuItem, MenuSeparator, MenuLabel, MenuItemProps`
- **message** (`@nucleux/message`) — A single chat message row with an avatar and a role-aware bubble. Pass
`content` for plain streamed text, or `children` for rich content
(markdown, code blocks, tool calls, etc.).

- **model-selector** (`@nucleux/model-selector`) — A composer-anchored dropdown for choosing which model handles the generation.

- **modular-consent** (`@nucleux/modular-consent`) — An agent permission/consent panel — a titled card with a checklist of

  Exports: `PageHeader, PageHeaderProps`
- **popover** (`@nucleux/popover`) — A click-triggered popover. Compose PopoverTrigger + PopoverContent. Closes on PopoverContent also accepts a deprecated `alignItems` prop (alias of `align`).
outside click or Escape. Content is positioned relative to the trigger.
  Exports: `Popover, PopoverTrigger, PopoverContent, PopoverProps, PopoverContentProps`
- **privacy-notice** (`@nucleux/privacy-notice`) — A subtle notice that a conversation is ephemeral or private — communicates

Source: Figma "Privacy and Control / temporary & incognito notices".
  Exports: `PrivacyNotice, PrivacyNoticeVariant, PrivacyNoticeProps`
- **progress** (`@nucleux/progress`) — A horizontal progress bar. Determinate when `value` is set, else indeterminate.
  Exports: `Progress, ProgressSize, ProgressProps`
- **prompt-enhancer** (`@nucleux/prompt-enhancer`) — A sparkle "enhance" pill plus one-tap rewrite intents for the user's draft —

Source: Figma "Prompt Scaffolds / Prompt Enhancer".
  Exports: `PromptEnhancer, PromptEnhancerProps`
- **prompt-template** (`@nucleux/prompt-template`) — A fillable prompt scaffold — a sentence with highlighted fill-in-the-blank

  Exports: `defaultTones, ToneSelector, ToneOption, ToneSelectorProps`
- **tool-call** (`@nucleux/tool-call`) — A collapsible card visualizing an agent tool/function call: its name, live

  Exports: `ToolCall, ToolCallProps`
- **tooltip** (`@nucleux/tooltip`) — Lightweight hover/focus tooltip. Reveals `content` when the wrapped trigger is
hovered or focused — no positioning library, pure CSS. The trigger must be
focusable (e.g. a button or link) for keyboard users.
  Exports: `Tooltip, TooltipSide, TooltipProps`
- **typing-indicator** (`@nucleux/typing-indicator`) — Three animated dots indicating the agent is preparing a response.
  Exports: `TypingIndicator, TypingIndicatorProps`
- **voice-input** (`@nucleux/voice-input`) — A composer in a live-dictation state — mic trigger, animated waveform while
recording, and a transcribing state — for voice input to the agent.
Source: Figma "Expressive Input / Voice Input".
  Exports: `VoiceInput, VoiceInputState, VoiceInputProps`
